title: Shim: Cryptographic JSONL Session Store, Bounded Agent Loop & 4-Layer Precedence Skill Loader
summary: Shim runs its agent loop in internal/agent/agent.go with MaxSteps defaulting to 16 and MaxTokens=8192 while embedding AGENTS.md capped at 64 KiB (64<<10) and active skill summaries into SystemPrompt with read-before-edit and untrusted-data framing. internal/session/session.go creates YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS-<4-byte crypto/rand hex> session IDs validated via validID() (1..64 chars [A-Za-z0-9-_]) in 0o700 dirs / 0o600 append-only JSONL files scanned up to 16 MiB (16<<20). internal/skills/skills.go discovers skills across GlobalDir < .shim/skills < .agents/skills < .claude/skills (last-wins override), caps frontmatter/body reads at 1 MiB (1<<20), and registers lazy load_skill.

references.description: SystemPrompt with 64 KiB AGENTS.md cap, MaxSteps=16, and MaxTokens=8192 loop
crypto/rand session ID generator, validID() 1..64 char guard, 0o700/0o600 JSONL persistence, and 16 MiB scanner cap
4-tier last-wins skill precedence, 1 MiB parse/load limit, and lazy load_skill read tool

author: repo-triad-forge
distilled_learning: Bound agent loops at MaxSteps=16 and AGENTS.md at 64 KiB, validate cryptographic JSONL session IDs with 0o700/0o600 permissions, and resolve layered skills with Global < .shim < .agents < .claude last-wins precedence.
